Move an existing agent setup into the charter and cut always-loaded context: run keystone allocate, review its classifications, then apply. Triggers: keystone allocate; keystone:allocate; /keystone:allocate; convert my .claude setup; migrate .cursorrules; trim CLAUDE.md; reduce context bloat.

Full dual-flywheel audit — Learning (capture from review) + Pruning (remove dead rules). Periodic charter hygiene. Triggers: keystone audit; keystone:audit; /keystone:audit; run audit; audit the charter; dual flywheel audit.

One-time initial charter scaffold — detect stack, seed state, scaffold idioms, classify hooks, build the globs index. Triggers: keystone bootstrap; keystone:bootstrap; /keystone:bootstrap; run bootstrap; bootstrap the charter; bootstrap the keystone charter; first-time setup.

Run the drift hook on the current diff — fast pre-verify check that loaded charter rules still match what the code is doing. Triggers: keystone check-drift; keystone:check-drift; /keystone:check-drift; check drift; run drift hook; drift check.

Triage the code-debt ledger — review the code-debt findings and update .agents/references/state/code-debt.md. Triggers: keystone debt-review; keystone:debt-review; /keystone:debt-review; review code debt; triage debt ledger; debt review.

Regenerate .keystone/INDEX.json — the primitive descriptor index every agent reads at session start. Triggers: keystone index; keystone:index; /keystone:index; refresh the keystone index; regenerate INDEX.json; reindex primitives.

Capture a learning candidate (surprise, incident, review finding) into .keystone/learning/inbox/ for later synthesis. Triggers: keystone learn; keystone:learn; /keystone:learn; run the learn command; capture a learning candidate; log a surprise.
Switch the charter pacing mode (paired / solo / autopilot). Triggers: keystone mode; keystone:mode; /keystone:mode; switch pacing mode; go autopilot; go solo; go paired.

Scaffold a new primitive (rule, reference, hook, permission, eval, skill, command, subagent, tool, document) at the canonical path. Triggers: keystone new; keystone:new; /keystone:new; add a rule; add a hook; add a skill; scaffold a primitive.

Define a host keystone has no built-in profile for (.agents/hosts/<name>.json): pick native, link, copy, or index per kind, then project to it. Triggers: keystone new adapter; keystone:new-adapter; /keystone:new-adapter; add a host; support a new coding agent; project to another agent.
Scaffold a new policy repo skeleton outside the current project. Triggers: keystone new policy; keystone:new-policy; /keystone:new-policy; bootstrap a policy repo; scaffold a keystone policy.

Enter the planning phase — load codebase state + matching idioms for the touched region, then sketch a plan. Triggers: keystone orient; keystone:orient; /keystone:orient; enter planning phase; orient on this task; load idioms for the touched region.

Run the four review subagents on the current diff (functional, security, risk, deployment). Triggers: keystone review; keystone:review; /keystone:review; review the diff; run review subagents; semantic review.

Capture intent + acceptance criteria for a unit of work. First action on any task. Triggers: keystone spec; keystone:spec; /keystone:spec; capture acceptance criteria; spec this task; what are we building.

Promote accepted learning-inbox candidates into the right reference / rule / hook layer, then refresh INDEX.json. Triggers: keystone synthesize; keystone:synthesize; /keystone:synthesize; run synthesize; promote learning candidates; promote inbox to rules.

Run the verification gate before a commit: every runnable hook (lint, type-check, test, build, drift, commit-message), then keystone verify for policy drift and strict locks. Triggers: keystone verify; keystone:verify; /keystone:verify; verify the charter cascade; audit policy drift; check strict violations.
End-to-end task workflow.
